meta.title: Digital Clock — Real-Time Online Clock (HH:MM:SS)
meta.description: A free online digital clock that displays the current time in real-time with hours, minutes, and seconds. No installation needed — just open and read the time.

howItWorks: The digital clock uses your device's local system time via the JavaScript Date object.
It updates every second to show the precise current time in HH:MM:SS format.
The time is based on your computer or phone's timezone settings — no internet sync required.
howToUse: Open the Digital Clock tool — it starts automatically.
Read the time displayed in large, easy-to-read digits.
Keep the tab open for a continuous real-time display.

faq.question: Does this clock work offline?
faq.answer: Yes. The digital clock uses your device's local system clock, so it works without an internet connection once the page is loaded.

faq.question: Can I use this as a full-screen clock?
faq.answer: Yes. You can use your browser's zoom feature to enlarge the display, or use full-screen mode (F11 on most browsers) for a bigger view.

faq.question: Is the time accurate?
faq.answer: The time matches your device's system clock. If your device time is correct, the digital clock will be accurate to the second.

examples.title: Real-time display
examples.description: The clock shows the current time updating every second.
